methodology.scope: 35 cross-source candidates observed in the Top-3 of BM25-all or Hybrid-all

relevanceScale.0: irrelevant or violates an explicit entity/category constraint
relevanceScale.1: tangential evidence that matches only a minor aspect
relevanceScale.2: useful evidence with one material constraint missing
relevanceScale.3: direct evidence for or against the requested choice

methodology.entityRule: When the question names a specific merchant, evidence about another merchant is irrelevant even if its wording is similar.
methodology.negativeEvidenceRule: Evidence against a choice can still be directly relevant when it addresses the requested constraint.
